_about: APPROVED EN/KM strings for the KruFace tool. This is the reviewed source of truth; the applied copy lives in src/lib/i18n/dictionary.ts. Values here were approved by the project owner.

_placeholders.{name}: a person's name, typed by the user

_placeholders_km_note: DECIDED: Khmer mode uses Western digits for every runtime number ({count}, {number}, {accuracy}) and for the raw counters rendered outside this file. No Khmer-numeral conversion happens at the substitution point.

auth.checking.where: Full-screen loading state while the account is verified. Shown before anything else, so it should feel calm and brief.
auth.checking.km: កំពុងពិនិត្យគណនី KruMath…

auth.signOut.where: Toolbar sign-out button. Used as both tooltip and screen-reader label, so keep it short.

account.label.where: Toolbar account menu: the avatar button's screen-reader label, and the fallback display name before the profile loads. km added for the account menu; pending native-speaker review.

account.settings.where: Item in the toolbar account menu -> krumath.com/settings. km added for the account menu; pending native-speaker review.
account.settings.km: ការកំណត់គណនី

nav.practice.where: App header tab -> the practice/home screen.

nav.people.where: App header tab -> the list of people.

nav.language.where: Screen-reader label for the EN/KM button group. Never seen visually.

toolbar.home.where: Toolbar tooltip -> krumath.com/home. Purely an icon, so this text is the only description users get.
toolbar.home.km: ទំព័រដើម KruMath

toolbar.github.where: Toolbar tooltip -> the GitHub repository, opens in a new tab.

toolbar.pricing.where: Toolbar tooltip -> krumath.com/pricing. Playful coffee wording; the link still points at the pricing page.
toolbar.pricing.km: ទិញកាហ្វេឱ្យខ្ញុំមួយកែវហេ៎?

home.status.loading.where: Small status pill on the home screen while data loads.
home.status.loading.km: កំពុងផ្ទុក…

home.status.ready.where: Status pill once there are enough faces to practise.
home.status.ready.km: រួចរាល់ក្នុងការអនុវត្ត

home.status.needMore.where: Status pill when there are not yet 4 faces. {count} is how many more are needed.
home.status.needMore.km: ត្រូវការ {count} ទៀតដើម្បីចាប់ផ្ដើម

home.title.where: The main headline. Currently two short parallel phrases for rhythm.
home.title.en: See the face. Remember the name.
home.title.km: មើលមុខ ចាំឈ្មោះ

home.subtitle.where: One- or two-sentence explanation under the headline. Khmer leads with the relatable problem (good with faces, bad with names) then the invitation.
home.subtitle.en: Good with faces but keep forgetting names? Come on — practice until you never forget a name again.
home.subtitle.km: ពូកែចាំមុខ តែភ្លេចឈ្មោះមែន? តស់! ហ្វឹកហាត់មើលមុខ ចាំឈ្មោះ កុំឱ្យភ្លេចឈ្មោះគេទៀត។

home.start.where: Primary button -> the quiz. Only shown when there are enough faces.
home.start.km: ចាប់ផ្ដើមអនុវត្ត

home.addPeople.where: Primary button -> the add-person screen. Shown instead of `home.start` when there are not enough faces.
home.addPeople.km: បន្ថែមមនុស្ស

home.accuracy.where: Label inside the stats pill, sitting next to a percentage like `82%`. Lowercase by design.
home.accuracy.km: ភាពត្រឹមត្រូវ

people.title.km: បញ្ជីមនុស្សរបស់អ្នក

people.count.where: Sub-line under the heading. {count} is the number of saved faces, so this must read correctly at 0, 1 and many.
people.count.km: មាន {count} នាក់ក្នុងបញ្ជីរបស់អ្នក

people.add.where: Button -> add-person screen. Also reused inside the quiz when there are too few faces.
people.add.km: បន្ថែមមនុស្ស

people.empty.where: Empty state: the whole screen becomes one big button with this label.
people.empty.km: បន្ថែមមនុស្សដំបូងរបស់អ្នក

people.remove.where: Tooltip on each card's X button. {name} is the person's name, so word order matters.

add.back.where: Button -> back to the people list.
add.back.km: ត្រឡប់ក្រោយ

add.save.where: Button that uploads the photo and saves the person.

add.saving.where: Same button while the upload is in flight. Must read as an in-progress state.
add.saving.km: កំពុងរក្សាទុក…

add.changePhoto.where: Tooltip once a photo is chosen, inviting a replacement.
add.changePhoto.km: ប្ដូររូបថត

add.choosePhoto.where: Tooltip before any photo is chosen.
add.choosePhoto.km: ជ្រើសរើសរូបថត

add.selectedPortrait.where: Screen-reader description of the chosen image. Never seen visually.
add.selectedPortrait.km: រូបថតដែលបានជ្រើសរើស

add.namePlaceholder.where: Name field hint, and the field's screen-reader label.

quiz.needMore_one.where: Shown when exactly 1 more face is needed. Kept as a separate key from the plural even though the two Khmer values are now identical: English needs the distinction ("1 more person" vs "3 more people"), and quiz.tsx chooses the key by count === 1.
quiz.needMore_one.km: បន្ថែម {count} នាក់ទៀតដើម្បីអនុវត្ត

quiz.needMore_other.where: Shown when 2 or 3 more faces are needed. {count} is that number.
quiz.needMore_other.km: បន្ថែម {count} នាក់ទៀតដើម្បីអនុវត្ត

quiz.back.where: Button -> home. Also the screen-reader label on that button.
quiz.back.km: ត្រឡប់ក្រោយ

quiz.question.where: Top-right progress text before any answer. {number} starts at 1.

quiz.progress.where: Top-right progress text once answering has begun. {accuracy} is a percentage, {count} is how many answered. The interpunct is part of the design - feel free to change it.

quiz.correct.where: Feedback after a right answer. Short, and green-coloured.
quiz.correct.km: ត្រឹមត្រូវ

quiz.wrongPickName.where: Feedback after a wrong answer when a photo was shown and the user had to pick the name. {name} is the correct answer, shown in bold at the end of the sentence.
quiz.wrongPickName.km: មិនទាន់ត្រូវទេ — ចម្លើយគឺ {name}។

quiz.wrongPickPhoto.where: Feedback after a wrong answer when a name was shown as the prompt and the user had to pick the photo. {name} is already on screen, so this describes the face they mis-picked instead of restating the answer.
quiz.wrongPickPhoto.km: មិនទាន់ត្រូវទេ — នេះមិនមែន {name} ទេ។

quiz.prompt.where: Screen-reader description of the question portrait, e.g. `Who is this?`. Never seen visually.
quiz.prompt.km: នេះជាអ្នកណា?

error.saveFailed.where: Warning under the Save button when the upload or database write fails. Shown in red.
error.saveFailed.en: Could not save that. Please try again.
error.saveFailed.km: មិនអាចរក្សាទុកបានទេ។ សូមព្យាយាមម្ដងទៀត។
